en: Black‑and‑white image of a landscaped courtyard between two multi‑storey classical-style buildings. In the center foreground is a garden with small fir trees and flower beds. Several people in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing, including uniformed men and individuals in white medical‑style coats, stand or walk along the paths. A long enclosed glass veranda or corridor connects the two main buildings. On the right stands a pedestal monument with a circular portrait relief of a bearded man and an inscription beneath it.
